sentiment.rationale: The company delivered a strong operational quarter with double-digit income growth in key segments and raised its underlying EPS, but forward guidance for 2025 was explicitly held below the medium-term range and the 2023-2026 CAGR target was merely reaffirmed as 'tracking towards the upper end.' Management language is confident on long-term prospects but explicitly 'watchful' of macro volatility and trade tariffs, which tempers the forward outlook. The score reflects genuine operational momentum without a formal guidance raise, offset by cautious forward language on 2025 growth.

summary.revenue: Underlying operating income of $5,390 million, up 7% at constant currency (ccy) and up 12% at ccy excluding notable items.
summary.eps: Underlying basic earnings per share of 62.7 cents, up 9.8 cents or 19% year-on-year. Reported basic EPS of 56.6 cents, up 10.1 cents or 22%.
summary.guidance: 2025 and 2026 guidance unchanged. Operating income to increase 5-7% CAGR in 2023-2026 at ccy excluding the deposit insurance reclassification; currently tracking towards the upper end of the range. 2025 growth expected to be below the 5-7% range at ccy excluding notable items. Operating expenses to be below $12.3bn in 2026 at ccy. RoTE approaching 13% in 2026 and to progress thereafter. Plan to return at least $8bn to shareholders cumulative 2024 to 2026.
summary.margin: Net interest margin (adjusted) of 2.12%, up 18 basis points year-on-year. Cost-to-income ratio of 54.1% (underlying), unchanged year-on-year. Underlying RoTE of 16.4%, up 120 basis points.
key_risks: Imposition of trade tariffs increasing global economic and geopolitical complexity.
Credit impairment charge up 24% to $219m, with charges mainly from higher interest rates impacting repayments in some unsecured portfolios.
Increased probability weighting for the Global Trade and Geopolitical Trade Tensions scenario due to heightened uncertainty around trade tariffs.
2025 income growth expected to be below the 5-7% range.
Net interest income outlook challenging to grow given the current interest rate environment and economic landscape.
Hong Kong CRE exposure risk of further impairment due to subdued economic activity in the property sector.
China CRE contagion risk remains limited but portfolio expected to be resilient despite market turbulence.
key_opportunities: Double-digit income growth in Wealth Solutions, Global Markets and Global Banking.
Presence in structurally high-growth markets across Asia, Africa and the Middle East.
Wealth Solutions momentum with 72,000 affluent new-to-bank clients onboarded and $13 billion of affluent net-new-money, up 22%.
Global Markets strong performance in both flow and episodic income.
Positive start to Q2'25 particularly in Global Markets.
Supply chain diversification and deeper international capital and foreign exchange markets as opportunities from trade tariffs.
Fit for Growth programme with expense saves of around $1.5bn.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management describes a 'strong performance' and states 'our ability to help clients manage their business and wealth across borders in times of volatility reinforces our confidence that we can continue to improve returns,' while also noting they remain 'watchful of the external environment.'
